Class Model.Player

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.Model.Player
Enclosing class:
Model
public class Model.Player extends Object
Represents an individual Player entity in the game (or the Thief/Opponent in Singleplayer). Holds the state for collected tiles, active character cards, current board position, and scoring components.

  • Field Details

    • name

      private final String name
      The display name of the player (e.g., "Player 1", "Thieve...").
      Invariant: Non-null after initialization.

    • id

      private final int id
      The numeric identifier for the player.
      Condition: Positive integer (1-4) for humans, -1 for the Thief/AI.

    • currentArea

      private String currentArea
      The category identifier of the area the player is currently occupying (e.g., "M", "S").
      Default: null (at the start of a turn).

    • lastArea

      private String lastArea
      The category identifier of the area the player visited in their previous turn.
      Used for: Validating moves that require moving to a different area.

    • RoundTilesCollected

      private int[] RoundTilesCollected
      An array tracking specific collection milestones for scoring (e.g., set completion).
      Invariant: Size is fixed at 8.

    • playertiles

      private final List<Model.InventoryTiles> playertiles
      The personal inventory list containing the count of every tile type collected by this player.
      Invariant: Initialized in constructor, never null.

    • playercards

      private final List<Model.CardTiles> playercards
      The list of Character Cards assigned to this player.
      Invariant: Initialized in constructor, never null.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(int id)
      Constructor for the Player class. Initializes the player's name, ID, and empty inventory/card lists. Pre-condition: id is a valid identifier (-1 or 1-4). Post-condition: A new Player object is created. Inventory lists are populated with zero counts. Cards are reset to available.
      Parameters:
      id - The unique numeric ID for the player.

    • GetOneTileFromTheBoard

      public void GetOneTileFromTheBoard(int index)
      Executes the logic for the player taking a specific tile from the board. Validates the move against game rules (e.g., must pick from adjacent areas unless a card is used). Pre-condition: The index corresponds to a valid tile on the board, and the player is allowed to make a move. Post-condition: 1. The tile count on the board decreases. 2. The player's inventory count for that tile increases. 3. The player's currentArea is updated to the tile's category. 4. If an active card was required for the move, it may be marked as used.
      Parameters:
      index - The index of the board tile button.

    • HelperForGetOneTileFromTheBoard

      void HelperForGetOneTileFromTheBoard(Model.ButtonTiles toChange, int arrayIndex)
      Internal helper method to update inventory and board arrays atomically during a move. Pre-condition: Valid toChange tile object and valid arrayIndex for the stats array. Post-condition: Arrays are updated to reflect the transfer of the tile from board to player.
      Parameters:
      toChange - The specific tile object on the board being modified.
      arrayIndex - The index in the boardTilesCollected array to update.

    • DisableAllCards

      public void DisableAllCards()
      Deactivates all Character Cards held by the player. Typically called at the end of a turn to reset temporary states. Pre-condition: None. Post-condition: All CardTiles in the player's list have their state set to false.
